description: This Java source file defines a class named ThreadCheckingRepaintManager that extends Swing's RepaintManager. It adds functionality to check whether Swing components are being accessed from the correct thread (the Event Dispatch Thread), and if not, outputs debugging information including stack trace and component tree.

classes.name: ThreadCheckingRepaintManager
classes.description: A custom RepaintManager that checks if Swing components are painted or updated from the correct thread (Event Dispatch Thread). If accessed from the wrong thread, it logs diagnostic information including stack trace and component hierarchy.

methods.name: ThreadCheckingRepaintManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the repaint manager; optionally sets whether to check if components are showing.

methods.name: addInvalidComponent
methods.description: Overrides the method to check thread before adding an invalid component for repaint.

methods.name: checkThread
methods.description: Checks if the current thread is the Event Dispatch Thread; if not, logs a warning, stack trace, and component tree.

methods.name: getStracktraceAsString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a stack trace from an exception.

methods.name: checkIsShowing
methods.description: Determines whether to check if a component is showing based on constructor parameter.

methods.name: addDirtyRegion
methods.description: Overrides the method to check thread before adding a dirty region for repaint.

methods.name: dumpComponentTree
methods.description: Prints the hierarchy of components from a given component upward, including visibility info.

methods.name: resetTabCount
methods.description: Resets indentation for component tree printing.

methods.name: incrementTabCount
methods.description: Increments indentation level for component tree printing.

methods.name: printTabIndent
methods.description: Prints tab characters according to current indentation level.
